MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small Gorilla epoxy feels like a natural next choice because I have used Gorilla tape and vinyl cement, and it offers another practical option for small repairs.",
    "The single tube of silicone sealant fits the sealing and repair needs suggested by my clamp and adhesive purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The inspection camera repeats a tool I already bought without giving me a reason to replace it.",
    "The screws and large heat shrink tubing require a specific size match that my history does not establish, while the polishing and cutting wheels assume projects and tools I have not indicated.",
    "Twelve tubes of super glue exceed what I want for occasional repairs, and I would choose the small clear epoxy before adding the steel-reinforced two-pack."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying clamps and connectors seems to have been taken as interest in almost any mechanical repair supply, even when its size or purpose may not fit.",
    "My previous inspection camera purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to buy another similar camera, although it may already meet that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I need a plausible current use, not just a connection to repair work; the nut assortment interests me, but I would wait until a job calls for it.",
    "Quantity, dimensions, and required tools affect whether I would choose something. My past bulk purchases do not mean I want every repair material in bulk."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but too often assume a current project, compatible equipment, or a need to replace something I already own."
}
